_note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for relationship modes, the feature registry, themes, fonts and section copy. This exact file also lives in frontend/src/config/siteConfig/ (they are deployed separately, so it is duplicated; backend/tests/siteConfig.test.js fails if the two copies differ). To add a feature: add an entry to `features`, gate its rendering in BirthdaySite, and copy the file.
